description: Source code implementing quantization and dequantization functions for tensors in PyTorch, including dynamic quantization, per-tensor and per-channel quantization, tensor cloning, and quantization parameter calculations.

methods.name: quantize_per_tensor_dynamic
methods.description: Dynamically quantizes a tensor based on min/max values and specified dtype, with support for reduce range and different quantization schemes.

methods.name: quantize_per_tensor
methods.description: Quantizes a tensor with specified scale and zero point.

methods.name: quantize_per_tensor_tensor_qparams
methods.description: Quantizes a tensor using per-tensor quantization parameters provided as tensors.

methods.name: quantize_per_tensor_list_cpu
methods.description: Quantizes a list of tensors with corresponding scales and zero points.

methods.name: quantize_per_channel
methods.description: Per-channel quantization of a tensor along a specified axis.

methods.name: dequantize_cpu_or_cuda
methods.description: Dequantizes a tensor to float, supporting CPU and CUDA tensors.

methods.name: dequantize_quantized
methods.description: Dequantizes a quantized tensor using its quantizer.

methods.name: dequantize_tensors_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Dequantizes a list of quantized tensors on CPU.

methods.name: q_scale_quant
methods.description: Retrieves the scale parameter from a quantized tensor's quantizer.

methods.name: q_zero_point_quant
methods.description: Retrieves the zero point parameter from a quantized tensor's quantizer.

methods.name: q_per_channel_scales
methods.description: Returns the per-channel scales tensor from a quantized tensor.

methods.name: q_per_channel_zero_points
methods.description: Returns the per-channel zero points tensor from a quantized tensor.

methods.name: q_per_channel_axis
methods.description: Returns the axis along which per-channel quantization is applied.

methods.name: make_per_channel_quantized_tensor_cpu
methods.description: Creates a per-channel quantized tensor on CPU with specified scales, zero points, and axis.

methods.name: set_storage_quantized_
methods.description: Sets storage, offset, sizes, and strides for a quantized tensor.

methods.name: qscheme_quant
methods.description: Returns the quantization scheme of a quantized tensor.

methods.name: quantized_clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a quantized tensor with optional memory format.

methods.name: equal_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Checks equality of two quantized tensors on CPU.

methods.name: _choose_qparams_per_tensor
methods.description: Calculates quantization parameters (scale and zero point) for a tensor.

methods.name: choose_qparams_optimized
methods.description: Finds optimal min/max for a tensor to minimize quantization error using a greedy approach.
